title: Missing skip link
user_impact: Keyboard users must tab through the entire navigation on every page change.
technical_impact: No link with a recognizable 'skip'/'to content' text or anchor to #main/#content at the top of the page.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks; techniques G1 (skip link at the top), ARIA11/H69 (landmarks, headings)
checks.applicability: Pages with blocks a keyboard user has to pass to reach the main content: links or other tab stops in front of it. A page without any link or focusable element has nothing to bypass.
checks.expectation:
needs_review once per page (page-level, at the root) when header or
navigation links precede the main content and no link bypasses them: no
fragment link to the start of the main content, no run of in-page links in
front of the first link that leaves the page. A skip link counts in any
language, also when it is visually hidden until focused, and also when a
script inserts it after load. Review, not violation: 2.4.1 can also be met by
landmarks and headings. A page without any link or focusable element is not
applicable (nothing to tab past).
